assessment_question: Can every deployed unit be identified consistently?
evidence_examples: VIN; serial number; internal unit ID; hardware revision

assessment_question: Can software and model versions be traced by unit and date?
evidence_examples: ADS version; model version; firmware; maps; release manifest

assessment_question: Is the safety-relevant hardware configuration recorded?
evidence_examples: Sensors; compute; communications; fallback equipment

assessment_question: Can a reviewer reconstruct what changed and who approved it?
evidence_examples: Deployment log; configuration diff; approval; rollback record

assessment_question: Are operating boundaries explicit and testable?
evidence_examples: Geography; road or facility type; task; weather; speed; hours

assessment_question: Is exposure measured by unit and period?
evidence_examples: Mileage; operating hours; trips; tasks; cycles

assessment_question: Can activity be separated into meaningful risk groups?
evidence_examples: Route; customer; cargo; passenger; task; use case

assessment_question: Are abnormal and out-of-domain events retained?
evidence_examples: Boundary excursion; override; degraded mode; exception log

assessment_question: Are operational and safety owners named?
evidence_examples: RACI; duty roster; deployment owner; incident lead

assessment_question: Are human assistance and override events recorded with context?
evidence_examples: Remote assist; takeover; stop; override; reason code

assessment_question: Can the company show who is qualified to operate and service the system?
evidence_examples: Training; certification; authorization; recency records

assessment_question: Are minimum-risk and emergency actions documented and tested?
evidence_examples: Shutdown; safe stop; escalation tree; emergency drill

assessment_question: Can scheduled work be compared with completed work by unit?
evidence_examples: Maintenance plan; work order; completion timestamp

assessment_question: Are inspection and calibration outcomes source-linked?
evidence_examples: Inspection checklist; calibration result; repair; return to service

assessment_question: Can defects be followed through closure?
evidence_examples: Defect log; recall; degradation alert; remediation evidence

assessment_question: Are software changes validated and reversible?
evidence_examples: Test result; approval gate; monitoring plan; rollback plan

assessment_question: Are incidents and near misses classified consistently?
evidence_examples: Collision; near miss; safety intervention; severity; event type

assessment_question: Can a reviewer reconstruct an event from primary evidence?
evidence_examples: Timeline; telemetry; video; system log; witness statement

assessment_question: Are injury property regulatory claim and loss outcomes connected to events?
evidence_examples: Claim file; payment; reserve; citation; third-party damage

assessment_question: Can the company show what changed after an event and whether it worked?
evidence_examples: Root cause; action owner; deadline; validation; recurrence monitor
